review_type: Independent source incorporation and evaluation-design review; actual response grading pending
summary: All six supplied themes are explicitly represented, the new style supersedes the earlier no-bold/no-list conventions, and the existing approval gates remain intact. One small worked-example presentation mismatch was identified. Actual response grading is pending.

themes.theme: Answer first or novice Big Picture
themes.evidence: docs/friendly-explanations.md:9 and :11 specify one bold direct sentence or at most three onboarding bullets; :13 bounds use.

themes.theme: Quoted human goal and control purpose
themes.evidence: docs/friendly-explanations.md:17 requires quoted question before procedure; :19 requires Why do this and concrete control reason.
docs/friendly-explanations.md:25–29 require two to four necessary terms where needed, original names, accurate definitions and analogy limitations.

docs/friendly-explanations.md:33–39 require brief quotations, original order, actual number meaning and unchanged tolerance. The conditional accuracy example correctly separates 13 percentage points from unprovided adequacy criteria.
docs/friendly-explanations.md:43–47 require 1–3 sentence paragraphs, bold 3–6 word list headlines, proportional separators and 3+ comparison summary tables.
docs/friendly-explanations.md:51–55 require actual file reading, supported locations and exact counting scope; local fixture checks three named functions.

approval_review.reason: Coordinator, worker and reviewer retain implementation, pre-execution, results-review and explicit acceptance requirements. Examples and explanations remain non-authorizing. One unfamiliar decision is distinguished from a requested connected-concept walkthrough; already familiar independent grouping is retained.

evaluation_design.reason: Five assistant-visible cases contain six turns; separate evaluator rubric records nine dimensions and exact turn states. Evaluation guide bars exposing future turns/answer key, requires source-read traces, records shared-context limitations and explicitly denies human-comprehension claims from scripted followups. Generic score fixture correctly uses drop 0.13; accuracy example separately defines a fraction before calling 13 percentage points.

findings.observed: New confusion-repair example puts four sentences into one quoted paragraph: Suppose... Keeping... I recommend... Should...
findings.requirement: docs/friendly-explanations.md:43 sets prose paragraphs to one to three sentences.
findings.resolution: Split the recommendation or focused question into a second quoted paragraph.

verification.scope: Fixture relationships, source functions, numerical facts and approval-state consistency only; not prose grading or human comprehension.
